# HOP parity criteria

Measured against the owner's mockup on 2026-10-08. Each line below is one criterion, written as the owner wrote it.

## Acceptance criteria

- The customer list shows 1 rows per page by default, and the page size can be changed to 25, 50 or 100.
2. The deal board keeps the filter a person set when they come back to it (criterion 2).
- [ ] When The contact page has nothing to show, it says **why** and offers the one action that would fill it.
- The activity feed answers within 2 s for a project with 10,000 records — measured at the 95th percentile.
5. A person without the `crm.edit` permission sees The quote editor read-only; every write control is hidden, not disabled.
- [ ] The task inbox sorts by "last touched" first; ties fall back to the record's name, A→Z.
- Every date on The report export reads in the person's own time zone, e.g. 08/10/2026 14:05 (GMT+7).
8. The login screen can be reached from the keyboard alone: Tab order follows the reading order, and Esc closes any dialog.
- [ ] Exporting The search bar to CSV includes exactly the columns on screen, in the same order; café-style accents survive the round trip.
- If saving on The settings page fails, the person's input stays in place and the error names the field at fault [see #10].
11. The customer list links each record to its owner; clicking the owner's name opens their profile in the same tab.
- [ ] Numbers on The deal board use thousands separators (1,234,567) and currency keeps 2 decimals ≥ 0.00.
- The contact page shows 13 rows per page by default, and the page size can be changed to 25, 50 or 100.
